hooks.command: PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/lib/preflight.mjs" ]; then (cd "$PKG" && node cli/lib/preflight.mjs --plugin flow --warn-only); elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then maude preflight --plugin flow --warn-only; fi

command -v kg >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PKG="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.."; if [ -f "$PKG/cli/bin/maude.mjs" ]; then (cd "$PKG" && node cli/bin/maude.mjs kg session-sync --warn-only >/dev/null 2>&1 &); elif command -v maude >/dev/null 2>&1; then (maude kg session-sync --warn-only >/dev/null 2>&1 &); fi
